result_summary.title: Event Tracker showing slow response and high latency in Sandbox
result_summary.description: We are experiencing performance issues with the Event Tracker in our Sandbox environment (EU-West). The response times are significantly slower than usual, and we are seeing high latency when trying to query event data. This is impacting our development workflow for approximately 85 users who rely on this tool for testing.
